title: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1

full_text: Article 6 (Holding of Meetings) In principle, the Strategy Meeting shall meet twice each year, once every six months: Provided, That the Chairperson may adjust the timing of meetings as necessary.
